reviews.reason: Copy and edit are module-level modal types with distinct input forms and submission callbacks; neither is defined inside another render. The panel tests submit a new id/name for Copy and edit WebMCP exposure separately.

PageDown/Next target the immediate successor of the displayed server page only if that render’s query result reports another page. PageUp/Previous target its predecessor only above page 1. These are synchronous input/button handlers with an absolute destination, not delayed callbacks or accumulated increments. Accumulating two updates against one availability check could skip an unverified page. The picker test observes page 1 → 2, a search reset to 1 and filtered page 2; it does not simulate batched keyboard events.
